title:
Office of
Dr. Khodadadi
text: Visibility, reflection and living energy.

title: Overall plan
text: Entrance, waiting area, meeting room and manager’s office.

title: Levels & ceiling
text: Floor, beam soffit and ceiling, read as separate architectural layers.

title: Arrival
text: Green metal, warm reflection and suspended artwork define the threshold.

title: A moment of pause
text: Leather seating, art and the Muscat horizon compose a calm waiting space.

title: Meeting room
text: Public access from waiting. Concealed access from the manager’s office. A composed digital presence.

title: Public access
text: Normal visitor access runs from the waiting room directly into the meeting room.
detail: Visitors enter from the waiting room. The manager uses a separate concealed doorway from the manager’s office.

title: Concealed manager access
text: A concealed doorway connects the manager’s office directly to the meeting room.
detail: This hidden connection is reserved for the manager. Normal visitor access is from the waiting room to the meeting room.

title: Controlled visibility
text: The suspended mirror stops above the floor, leaving a low strip open.
detail: The approximately 50 cm opening makes occupancy legible at floor level while screening seated eye-level views.

title: Reflection & presence
text: The mirror extends visual depth by reflecting people and the room.
detail: Reflection is a conceptual expression of openness and mutual presence. The mirror remains opaque; it is not transparent glass.

title: The online frame
text: The head seat is composed with ATLAS and greenery behind it.
detail: For an energy company, light and planting evoke life, renewal and movement. They give the brand a living backdrop rather than a neutral wall.

title: The planted edge
text: Layered planting and filtered glass soften the boundary and daylight.
detail: Greenery supports the energy-company narrative through light and living growth. This is a spatial and symbolic intention, not a claim of energy performance.

title: Meeting room details
text: Select a numbered point to inspect its architectural role.
spots: The silver mirror reflects the cactus and the room. Its lower edge leaves a gap above the floor, allowing discreet occupancy reading.
The freestanding curved bronze surface stops below the concrete ceiling. Concealed light emphasizes the separation above it.
The cylindrical pendant directs light toward the cactus below, forming a vertical focal point.
The cactus and its bronze planter form the living sculpture beside the reflected image.
Filtered glazing and planting bring a layered green presence and softened daylight into the room.

title: Designed for the camera
text: The portrait frame includes the head seat, ATLAS mark and greenery.
detail: Light and living growth express the energy company’s identity. This overlay shows the proposed composition; the final crop depends on camera position and lens.

title: Manager’s office
text: A central presence, framed by a personal collection.

title: Triangular focus
text: Two lateral display systems direct attention toward the manager.
detail: The diagram expresses a perceptual triangle between the side displays and the central seated position.

title: The ATLAS pupil
text: The manager occupies the symbolic pupil at the center of the composition.
detail: A conceptual reading of the ATLAS triangle and eye: awareness, focus and presence. This schematic is not a replacement brand mark.

title: Collection as identity
text: Books, objects and models become part of the architectural composition.
detail: Integrated display shelves hold the personal collection within the overall order of the room.

title: Spatial layers
text: Lounge, formal desk, display systems and planted edge.

title: Authority & hospitality
text: Select a numbered point to explore the composition.
spots: The left display system integrates books and objects into the architecture.
The central desk is the visual focus between the two display systems.
The right display system presents the manager’s curated collection.
